verdict.rationale: AI Gateway provides dynamic routing with a visual or JSON-based configuration that evaluates conditions, enforces budget/rate quotas, and chooses models with fallbacks—directly enabling policy-based mid-task model switching by cost, capability (paid/non-paid segments), or availability. Fallback chains, retry logic, and the cf-aig-step header confirm actual model-switching behavior on failure/timeouts, and Universal endpoint plus OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions make switching providers/models low-friction.
